text.body: Samvarodayatantra ch. 12. mantrajāpākṣamālānirdeśapaṭalaḥ % \A = Matsunaga 404. 1595 AD. śṛṇu vajrādhipa samyak akṣasūtrasya lakṣaṇam | yena samyagvidhānena sidhyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 12.1. || % sidhyante ] siṃte \A suvarṇarajataṃ tāmra cā sphaṭikaṃ śaṃkhādim eva ca | yojayec chāntipuṣṭau gulikāntike || 12.2. || % suvarṇa ] sūvarṇa \A aṣṭottaraśata gulikā puṣṭikarmaṇi śasyate | rājaheto japet mantrī śrīsaṃpattimukhotsavam || 12.3. || % saṃpatti ] sampartti \A kuṅkumādi tu gandhādi pravālaṃ raktacandanabījakam | vaśyākṛṣṭiprayogeṣu pañcāśa gulikā sadā || 12.4. || % gandhādi ] ga<x ddhā x>dhādi \A rudrākṣāriṣṭrabījaṃ tu narāsthi tu tathaiva ca | uṣṭrakharamahīṣāsthi tu tva abhicāre mūkastambhane || 12.5. || % mahī(\A 34v)ṣāsthi % stambhane ] stambhanya \A māraṇoccāṭanaṃ yojya vidveṣe śatrunigrahe | yathākarma viśeṣeṇa akṣasūtraṃ ca kārayet || 12.6. || gardabhoṣṭrakeśais tu kākapakṣeṇa miśritam | stambhanoccāṭakarmeṣu tasya sūtreṇa granthitam || 12.7. || % pakṣaṇa ] pakṣeṇa \A % miśritam ] misitaṃ \A % karmeṣu ] karmeṣu \A % granthitam ] ganthi \A hayameṣakeśena viśena vidveṣe asya sūtrayoḥ | śmaśānakeśasūtreṇa śvānaromena miśritam || 12.8. || % meṣa ] maṣa \A % sūtreṇa ] mūtrena \A tasya sūtraṃ praśasyante krūrakarmaṇi yojayet | kumārīkarttitasūtreṇa granthayet śubhakarmaṇi || 12.9. || % krūra ] krura \A % granthayet ] ganthayet \A śāntike tarjanī nyasta pauṣṭike madhyamā sadā | anāmā vaśyam ity uktaṃ paryantenābhicārataḥ || 12.10. || % pauṣṭike ] prauṣṭike \A aṅguṣṭhā devatārūpaṃ sarvakarmasu yojayet | ahanta gulikāṃ sarva dharmadhātusvarūpataḥ || 12.11. || (\A 35r) % aṅguṣṭhā ] aguṣṭhā \A samāhitaṃ jāpabhāvena akṣasūtraṃ viśeṣitam | kṛta yujayed ekaṃ tretāyā dviguṇaṃ japet || 12.12. || % ? kṛtayuge japed ekaṃ \conj % dviguṇaṃ ] diguṇaṃ \A dvāpare triguṇaṃ proktaṃ kalau jāpaś caturguṇāḥ | japet mantram avicchinnaṃ catvāro mantrarūpataḥ || 12.13. || % caturguṇāḥ ] catuguṇāḥ \A pravyāhāram idaṃ jāpam akṣasūtrādi saṃgraṃ | upalambha devatārūtā rūpaṃ spharaṇaṃ saharaṇātmakam || 12.14. || āgatā gati saṃcintya saṃketamantratattvataḥ | trayakotimiva nimūkta tathatā pāramārthikam | eteṣāṃ mantrajāpasya lakṣaṇaṃ vidhir ucyate || 12.15. || iti mantrajāpākṣamālānirdeśapaṭalo dvādaśaḥ || || % nirdeśa ] niddeśa \A
